correctness.rationale: The determinant-volume identity follows from the path incidence Gram determinant recurrence; cyclic cut markings give uniform positive compositions and the exact all-real-moment coefficient formula. The adjacent Gamma-ratio quotient proves the sharp one-third peak and ties. A conditional joint-Fourier CLT, including an explicit uniform tail and lattice-frequency bound, yields the positive Schur-complement variance; Stirling and an exact KL identity yield the exponential annealed–typical separation. The embedded standalone verifier completed 2,086 checks, including exact exhaustive Gram computations for n<=10 and independent finite conditional fluctuation calculations; finite checks do not substitute for the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The changing dimension of edge-deleted forest polytopes motivates the canonical cross-polytope metric normalization. The normalized expected squared intrinsic volume has an exact, nonmonotone one-third deletion optimum; despite this, the realized normalized volume fluctuates lognormally and its mean is exponentially inflated by atypical rooted-forest gap profiles. The explicit conditional variance and strictly positive KL rate together form a reusable geometric-probabilistic description, not an arbitrary finite table, and quantify a structural distinction between average and typical metric size.
